# Vendored libraries

Copied unchanged from their published builds, pinned to one version each.

| File | Library | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `highlight.min.js`, `github.min.css`, `github-dark.min.css` | highlight.js | 11.10.0 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.10.0/ | BSD-3-Clause, `highlight.LICENSE` |
| `marked.min.js` | marked | 14.1.4 | cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@14.1.4/marked.min.js | MIT, `marked.LICENSE.md` |

To upgrade, replace the files from the same sources at the new version and
update this table.
